Messages.Author: Jyhad_addict
Messages.Body:
If a methuselah is left with an empty hand during his untap, by
burning cards to untap minions that are not immune to NuN, can he fail
to burn a card to untap a minion ?

If not, then this card is the true weenie bane.

Because when you play with 10+ low-cap minions, then it is a matter
of few turns before you run out of library cards and additionaly you
cannot untap more than x minions by burning cards (x = your hand
size).
